acceptanceCriteria: A constant name inside a heredoc body creates no advisory edge, covered by a test
Nested module constant resolution (Foo::Bar referenced as Bar inside module Foo) resolves correctly in a test
body: Residual from V1-1795 (PR #1146). The autoload constant scanner does not mask heredoc bodies and approximates module/class nesting. Constant-looking words inside heredocs therefore create extra ADVISORY_CONSTANT_REFERENCE edges. This only over-selects, so it is safe but costs precision. Expected: heredoc bodies are masked like string literals, and nesting follows module/class/end. Observed in PR #1146, 2026-10-18.
